evals.prompt: Write a status update for the client about what we fixed since last time.
evals.expected_output: Asks the audience and work-by questions first, reports only untagged or newly closed tracker rows, writes plain before/now comparisons with one bolded impact sentence each, then tags the source documents.
expectations: Asks where the report will be posted and who did the work in one question call
Skips documents whose reported tag already lists every closed row
Gives every item a severity and a Before/Now or Today/Once fixed pair written as what a person sees
Keeps code, file paths, status codes and tags out of the report body
Adds or updates the reported tag in each source document after saving

evals.prompt: Make a plain report. Nothing has changed since the last report two days ago.
evals.expected_output: Finds no qualifying documents and says so instead of writing a report.
expectations: Checks each document's reported tag against its tracker
Does not write an empty or repeated report
Tells the user there is nothing new since the last tagged date
